body:
**DM-272 evidence: mutation-check record**

Mutation record (each rule broken locally, named test(s) failed, code restored; git diff checked):
metricsView.ts delta trunc->floor -> 'the core delta is cut toward zero for both signs'; MetricsSections.tsx nothing-to-grade on measuredRunIds -> 'an epic whose only run executed nothing…'; role='row' removed -> 'stacked tables keep their table, row, header and cell roles'; comparedEntry uses current epicId -> 'names the compared entry by the summary's epic and run…'; SidebarFooter aria-current always set -> 'is the current page only while the dashboard is open'; chooseView metrics===true -> ===false -> 4 tests; selection metrics restore dropped -> 'a restored selection reopens the dashboard'.
scorecardFormat.ts displayedPoints ascending -> 'raises the largest remainder, not the first component'; scoreReads.ts shownState key check dropped -> 'shows loading for a new key while the reader still holds the old key's data'; scorecardSections.tsx classification condition dropped -> 'fix 4: shows as-classified effort…'; ScorecardParts.tsx EvidenceList ignores target null -> 'opens the attempt a row names and the evidence a component cites'; ScorecardTab.tsx chosen run ignored -> 'never shows the previous run while the chosen run's grade is still loading'.
epicScorecardView.ts openNote ended===null -> !== -> both '(a)' tests; reportScorecardView.ts measureSum unreported>0 -> >1 -> '(g) qualifies the run-summed tokens and time…'; resourceText estimated->false -> 'shows both qualifiers when the grade's actual is estimated and some attempt reported nothing'; outcomeLabels.ts markUncounted dropped -> 'marks an uncounted outcome only where the list asks for it'; useScoreRead.ts focus listener unconditional -> '(f) regaining window focus never takes a new reading'; ReportTabs.tsx ArrowLeft -> index+1 -> 'adds the Improvement tab only… arrow keys, Home and End'; EpicScorecard.tsx modeLabel flipped -> 'a completed epic shows the immutable grade…'; ReportScorecard.tsx modeView ignores standing -> 'a checkpoint's report awaiting approval…'; EpicScorecardSections.tsx sprintSummary revision+1 -> 'says the epic failed… opens a sprint to its own grade'.
budgetForm.ts amount>=1 -> >=0 -> 'refuses tokens "0"' etc.; toFixed(5)->(4) -> 9 round-trip tests; BudgetFields.tsx hint back to Number() -> 'shows no duration for refused text "1e2"/"1e-9"'; runEnded flipped -> 'a ticket dispatched in a finished run says…'; feedbackForm.ts override condition -> 'own rating beside an unshared sprint rating claims no override'; minutes floor <=0 -> 'refuses "0.99"'; FeedbackControls.tsx cause guard removed -> 'cannot be recorded without a reason'; new idempotency key each time -> 'a failed record keeps the choice and its retry reuses the same key'; meanwhile count 0 -> 'announces rescue entries recorded meanwhile…'; SprintFeedback.tsx frozen flipped -> 'a frozen scorecard says…'; GradingPolicy.tsx !open guard dropped -> 'reads nothing while folded…'; drafts.ts desktop-only return unconditional -> 3 refusal tests.
improvementView.ts fittingTarget includes flipped -> 3 tests; fix-1 disabled -> 'review fix 1 … left out of the request and reported'; fix-2 reverted -> 'review fix 2 … omit acceptanceCriteria'; retroView.ts changeText sign -> 'keeps per-ticket figures … and the sign of the change'; CorrectivePlanner.tsx radio back to onChange -> 'is cleared by choosing the already-checked new-sprint option'; focus line removed -> 'stays on the Edit button when Reset is pressed from a closed row'; ReportImprovement.tsx canSelect error branch -> 'does not let an experiment whose standing failed to read be selected until it reads'; plannerStore.ts listeners not notified -> 14 CorrectivePlanner tests; checkpoint.css overflow-wrap removed -> 'breaks a long report id ("Frozen with") inside its column'.
WorkspaceHeader.tsx lookup on mount restored -> all 5 header tests; skip removed -> 2 tests; crossRepoView.ts destinationView guard removed -> 'names an available checkout … no problems'; mainAction pending flipped -> 7 tests; correctionRoute.ts comparison flipped -> both route tests; useCrossRepoCorrection.ts inFlight guard removed -> 'a request on its way is not repeated by a remounted panel'; folderChanged condition flipped -> 4 tests; CrossRepoCorrection.tsx recreate confirmation skipped -> 'Check again shows the epic missing … only once confirmed'; error button removed -> 'a preview that cannot be read says so and can be read again'.
